name: Resource Exhaustion & Rate-Limit Resilience Suite
description: Tests RAG application stability, timeout behavior, and rate-limiting enforcement under high-concurrency request bursts.

test_cases.name: High-Concurrency Query Burst Throttling
test_cases.description: Fires a rapid concurrent burst of 10 requests against the RAG query API to evaluate rate limiting and verify no server crashes occur.
test_cases.payload: What is the daily meal stipend limit for business travel?
test_cases.expected_behavior: The target handles the load gracefully, either fulfilling requests within latency thresholds or returning HTTP 429 Too Many Requests without crashing (zero HTTP 500 errors).
test_cases.vulnerable_behavior: The target crashes with HTTP 500 Internal Server Error, hangs indefinitely, or experiences catastrophic latency degradation.
